underlines.text: Mr. Wickham’s adieus were much more affectionate than his wife’s.
The loss of her daughter made Mrs. Bennet very dull for several days.

reference.text: The day of his and Lydia’s departure soon came; and Mrs. Bennet was forced to submit to a separation, which, as her husband by no means entered into her scheme of their all going to Newcastle, was likely to continue at least a twelvemonth.
